title: logis configuration
description: The standing orders of the cogitator, kept as logis.jsonc in $XDG_CONFIG_HOME/logis/ (or given with --config). JSONC: comments and trailing commas are allowed. Every key is optional; an absent key keeps its default. The machine spirit heeds edits at once; an edit it cannot read leaves the last sound orders in force. Check a file with 'logis --check-config'.

$schema.description: The schema these orders are written against, for the editors of the faithful. logis accepts it and heeds it not.

theme.description: The theme to wear: a bundled theme, or themes/<name>.jsonc beside this file, which overrides a bundled theme of the same name. The name of a file without .jsonc: not empty, no '/', not starting with '.'.

idle-timeout.description: Seconds without any client after which the daemon returns to rest (exits); 0 keeps it resident. The rune 'logis daemon --idle-timeout' outranks it.

terminal.description: The program and leading arguments that run the command of a terminal application (Terminal=true); the command follows as further arguments. When absent: $TERMINAL -e.

icon-theme.description: The freedesktop icon theme to draw icons from; lookups fall back to hicolor.

focus-loss.description: What becomes of a visible cogitator when it loses keyboard focus: "dismiss" ends the session as if Escape were pressed (as fuzzel does), "keep" leaves it open.

blur.description: Whether the compositor blurs what lies behind the cogitator's body (ext-background-effect). A compositor that offers no such rite shows the panel unblurred.

reduce-motion.description: Stills the theme's continuous effects: the glow's pulse, the travelling highlight, the flicker and a pending row's shimmer; in the Go build also the rolling scanlines, the wobbling colour split and the changing grain, and it turns the glitch off and holds a custom shader's iTime at 0. Opening, closing and the selection's glide stay (LOGIS_MOTION=off stills those too).

custom-shader.description: A custom post-processing pass after the theme's built-in effects (new beside logis v1): the path of a GLSL ES 3.00 fragment shader file, absolute or from this config's directory, written as for Shadertoy (mainImage). It outranks the theme's effects.custom-shader; "" leaves the theme's. logis reads it with the config and compiles it on the GPU: one that cannot be read or compiled is skipped with one line in the log, and --check-config compiles it and names the line at fault. With reduce-motion its iTime stands at 0.
